offering_description.value: Provides drinking water and wastewater services to residential, commercial, industrial, and government customers, mainly in Delaware, with some service in Maryland and Pennsylvania. It also provides water for fire protection and offers contract operations and related services. It treats and distributes water through its own wells, treatment plants and pipeline network.

primary_products.value: treated drinking water; water for fire protection

primary_services.value: water distribution; wastewater collection and treatment; contract water and sewer operations; plumbing and water line protection plans

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households receiving water and wastewater service; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, and other utilities buying water; B2G: municipalities and government entities for fire protection and public water service

end_markets.value: residential water supply; commercial and industrial water supply; municipal fire protection; wastewater services

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated metered water and wastewater rates charged to customers; service fees: contract operations, plumbing and service line protection plans

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates wells, treatment plants, pipelines and wastewater systems serving retail and wholesale customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Delaware primarily, plus Maryland and Pennsylvania

specialization.value: related lines: water utility, wastewater utility, and related water services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: water delivered directly to customers through company-owned pipeline network

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates regulated by Delaware Public Service Commission, subject to EPA and state drinking water and environmental rules
